(Source: Crunchyroll)
data.background: Anime Kapibara-san (アニメ カピバラさん) is an anime based on Bandai Spirits' capybara character, Kapibarasan, which has inspired a long-running line that includes merchandise, manga adaptations, and spin-off characters. The anime is being created to celebrate the 15th anniversary of Bandai Spirits. It is being directed by Tomohiro Tsukimi, who is also credited as the sound director, with music by Akiyuki Tateyama and animation production by Shin-Ei Animation and L'esprit. It is part of the show Kinder TV (TV Tokyo).

data.title: Boukyaku Battery
data.title_japanese: 忘却バッテリー
data.synopsis:
High school student Tarou Yamada wants to escape his past as a baseball player after a devastating loss against an elite team. Though the new school he attends has no record of the sport, Yamada reencounters the same foes from that fateful day where he experienced his greatest failure. Unsure of why his former opponents are now attending the same school, Yamada wonders if he will truly be able to move away from his passion for baseball.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

data.synopsis: In the 21st century, due to the rapid development of human society, the originally stable three realms of humans, gods, and demons lost their balance. The gods and Demons urgently launched the salvation plan and decided to send a group of gods and monsters to the human world to find the key to saving the world. Su Moting is a young woman with the status of "the son of the god and demon". After being invited out of the house by her parents for the reason of "independence and self-improvement", Su Moting met the handsome little cute gods, Tianjixing and Dikui, a mysterious calm cool cat demon. Under the guidance of the land god, the three formed a salvation group and began to perform the funny and heartbreaking nonsense of daily life.

She learns of the "Star Palace," where the 12 Star Princesses of the constellations kept the balance of the universe until they were attacked. Lala is searching for the legendary Precure warriors to help find the 12 scattered "Princess Star Color Pens" and revive the princesses. data.title: Jue Shi Wu Hun
data.title_japanese: 绝世武魂
data.synopsis:
In the continent of Longmai, thousands of clans stand tall, countless sects exist, and cultivation is the way of life. The strong can do anything they want while the weaklings live like ants. Youngster Chen Feng has an incomplete dan region, causing him to be unable to cultivate, he withstood countless sneers directed at him. Until he obtained a mysterious dragon bloodline, breaking out of his cocoon and opening a new chapter to his life! Coquettish demonic fox spirits, cold female emperors, demon girls or princesses from a prestigious clan, all of them jump into my embrace. With the unparalleled inheritance, I will manifest the strongest martial spirit, obtain all the beauties and look down from the heavens.

(Source: AC.QQ, translated)
data.background: Adapted from Chengdong Luo's (洛城东) novel by the same title.

data.title: Wan Jie Fa Shen
data.title_japanese: 万界法神
data.synopsis:
At the end of the calendar 2020, the continent of Stern, which has reached the end of civilization due to the exhaustion of magic elements, ushered in the destruction of the continent under the void storm. Ye Xuan, the last god of law in the mainland, unexpectedly awakened in the era of the prosperous magic civilization three thousand years ago and became an ordinary student at the Sith Magic Academy on the border of the Kingdom of Orlando in the northwest of the mainland. In order to save the mainland and prevent the end from coming, Ye Xuan began to explore the mystery of the dark turmoil that led to the depletion of magical elements in the mainland three thousand years ago, to prevent the mainland crisis.

(Source: Donghua Info)

data.synopsis:
Transmigrating to a cultivation world only to find himself not fitting the protagonist's character description, Dongfang Xianyun mistakenly identifies his second junior brother, Yin Feixing, who has been reborn for revenge, as the "protagonist." Intending to cling to the protagonist's coattails to survive, he is instead kicked off a cliff by his "cog," thus embarking on the path of a demonic cultivator villain. Characters such as the naive and innocent Mahayana-stage demonic cultivator Yi Xiangfeng, the playboy Dongfang Wuqiong, the eldest disciple of the Xuanming Sect, and the Heavenly Dao Messenger Bu Suantian, also a transmigrator, all make their appearance. The Demon Subduing Assembly brings together a storm of events, and the battle between righteous and demonic cultivators is about to erupt. Dongfang Xianyun, the former eldest disciple of the Xiaoyao Sect and now the senior demonic cultivator of the Bai Mei Sect, is caught in a life-or-death crisis…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
